claim.claim-text: 1. A system (10) for in-line treatment of thread (20) for use with a thread consuming device (15), comprising:

2. The system according to claim 1, wherein the system (10) further comprises a thread feeder (130) arranged upstream of the print heads (151a-d) and wherein the control unit (190) is configured to stop the thread feeder (130) once the control unit has determined that a maintenance sequence is to be performed.
3. The system according to any one of claims 1-2, wherein during the maintenance sequence, the thread consuming device (15) is consuming thread (20) from the buffer.
4. The system (10) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the control unit (190) is configured to:
receive the current operating speed of the thread consuming device (15), and determine if a maintenance sequence is to be performed at least based on said current operating speed.
5. The system (10) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the control unit (190) is further configured to:
receive the thread consumption of the thread consuming device (15), and determine if a maintenance sequence is to be performed at least based on said thread consumption.

6. The system (10) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the control unit (190) is further configured to control one or more print heads to be arranged in an operation mode, simultaneous as one or more print heads are arranged in a maintenance mode.

7. The system (10) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the control unit (190) is further configured to determine if a maintenance sequence is to be performed at least based on a predetermined operating pattern.

8. The system (10) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the control unit (190) is further configured to determine if a maintenance sequence is to be performed at least based on an estimated consumption of the coating substance.

9. The system according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the control unit (190) is further configured to determine a time interval for said maintenance, and to determine if a maintenance sequence is to be performed at least based on said time interval.
10. The system according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the maintenance sequence is performed without stopping the thread consumption of the thread consuming device (15).

11. The system according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the control unit (190) is further configured to alter the number of active nozzles (152a-f) based on the current required flow rate of the one or more coating substances and/or based on desired visual appearance of the thread (20).

12. The system according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the control unit (190) is further configured to determine if a maintenance sequence is to be performed on at least the first print head (151a), and if so schedule said maintenance sequence on the at least he first print head (151a).
13. The system according to any of the preceding claims, further comprising a thread consuming device (15).

14. The system according to claim 13, wherein the thread consuming device (15) is an embroidery machine, a sewing machine, a knitting machine, a weaving machine, a tufting machine, a thread winding machine, and or any combination thereof.
15. A method for in-line treatment of at least one thread (20), comprising:

providing a treatment unit (100) comprising at least a first and a second print head (151a, 151b) wherein the each print head (151a-d) comprises a plurality of nozzles (152a-f) arranged at different positions relative the at least one thread (20), said at least one thread (20) being in motion in use, and each nozzle (152a-f) being configured to dispense one or more coating substances onto the at least one thread (20) when activated, providing a thread buffer system being arranged downstream the at least two print heads (151a-d); and providing a control unit (190) configured to determine if a maintenance sequence is to be performed on at least the first print head (151a), wherein the control unit (190) is further configured fill up the thread buffer system when it is determined that a maintenance sequence is to be performed.
